verdict.rationale: There is a dedicated first-party docs page (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thinking) confirming Gemini exposes model reasoning via 'thought' steps in the Interactions API, indicating a documented thinking/reasoning surface. However, the excerpted text only describes how reasoning output is surfaced, not the specific request parameters (e.g., effort/budget levels) an ml-engineer would set to control how hard the model thinks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tunable reasoning-effort/thinking-budget parameters, independent/hands-on confirmation that effort levels can be adjusted via the API.
